fact_text: The minimum EP qualifying salary for candidates aged 23 or below (all sectors except financial services) is SGD 5,600 per month, increasing progressively with age up to SGD 10,700 at age 45 and above.
evidence_quote: $5,600 (increases progressively with age from age 23, up to $10,700 at age 45 and above)

fact_text: For the financial services sector, the minimum EP qualifying salary starts at SGD 6,200 (age 23 or below), increasing up to SGD 11,800 at age 45 and above.
evidence_quote: Financial services $6,200 (increases progressively with age from age 23, up to $11,800 at age 45 and above)

fact_text: EP candidates must pass a two-stage eligibility framework: Stage 1 requires meeting the EP qualifying salary, and Stage 2 requires passing COMPASS (unless exempted).
evidence_quote: To qualify for EP applications, candidates will need to pass a 2-stage eligibility framework: Stage 1 Earn at least the EP qualifying salary, which is benchmarked to the top 1/3 of local PMET salaries by age. Stage 2 Unless exempted, pass the points-based Complementarity Assessment Framework (COMPASS).

fact_text: The Employment Pass is for foreign professionals, managers and executives with a job offer in Singapore who meet the eligibility criteria.
evidence_quote: Who it is for Foreign professionals, managers and executives with a job offer in Singapore who meet the eligibility criteria.

fact_text: An employer or appointed employment agent must apply for the EP on behalf of the candidate — the candidate cannot apply themselves.
evidence_quote: Who can apply An employer or appointed employment agent needs to apply on behalf of the candidate.

fact_text: For first-time EP candidates the pass is valid for up to 2 years; on renewal it is valid for up to 3 years.
evidence_quote: What is the duration The duration of the pass is as follows: First-time candidates: Up to 2 years Renewals: Up to 3 years

fact_text: The Employment Pass allows foreign professionals, managers, executives and technicians to work in Singapore, with a minimum salary of SGD 5,600 per month.
evidence_quote: The Employment Pass allows foreign professionals, managers, executives and technicians to work in Singapore. Candidates need to earn at least $5,600 a month.

fact_text: An EP application must earn at least 40 points to pass COMPASS.
evidence_quote: Your application needs to earn 40 points to pass COMPASS.

fact_text: COMPASS (Complementarity Assessment Framework) is a transparent points-based system that enables employers to select high-quality foreign professionals while improving workforce diversity and building a strong local core.
evidence_quote: COMPASS is a transparent points-based system that gives businesses greater clarity and certainty for manpower planning. It enables employers to select high-quality foreign professionals, while improving workforce diversity and building a strong local core.

fact_text: COMPASS C1 (Salary) criterion: candidates earn 20 points if at the 90th percentile or above, 10 points if at the 65th to below 90th percentile, and 0 points if below the 65th percentile, compared to local PMET salaries in their sector.
evidence_quote: Candidate's fixed monthly salary compared to salary benchmarks by sector Points 90th percentile and above 20 65th to less than 90th percentile 10 Below 65th percentile 0

fact_text: COMPASS C3 (Diversity) criterion awards points based on the share of the candidate's nationality among the firm's PMETs: less than 5% share earns 20 points; 5% to less than 25% earns 10 points; 25% or more earns 0 points.
evidence_quote: Share of candidate's nationality among organisation's PMETs Points Less than 5% 20 5% to less than 25% 10 25% or more 0

fact_text: Candidates earning a fixed monthly salary of at least SGD 22,500 are exempt from the COMPASS assessment.
evidence_quote: Have a fixed monthly salary of at least $22,500

fact_text: COMPASS C2 (Qualifications) criterion: top-tier university degrees earn 20 points; other degree-equivalent qualifications earn 10 points; no degree-equivalent qualifications earn 0 points.
evidence_quote: Degree-equivalent qualifications from the following institutions: Top 100 universities based on QS World University Rankings, and other highly-reputed universities in Asia Singapore's Autonomous Universities Institutions that are highly-recognised in a particular field and endorsed by a relevant agency 20 Other degree-equivalent qualifications: Foreign qualifications that are assessed to be comparable to a bachelor's degree in the UK system. MOM determines this with reference to international recognition bodies, such as the UK National Information Centre for recognition and evaluation of international qualifications and skills (UK ENIC). Professional qualifications that are well-recognised by the industry and endorsed by a relevant sector agency. Foreign qualifications awarded by local private education institutions (PEIs) may also be considered. Find out more about how PEIs qualify. 10 No degree-equivalent qualifications: These qualifications will not earn any points under COMPASS. Do not submit them. Candidates without degree-equivalent qualifications can still pass COMPASS by earning a total score of at least 40 points from other criteria. 0

fact_text: The Employment Pass application is submitted online by the employer or appointed employment agent via the EP eService.
evidence_quote: You can apply for an Employment Pass online as an employer or appointed employment agent.

fact_text: The EP application fee is SGD 105, payable by GIRO, Visa, Mastercard or Amex.
evidence_quote: Pay the $105 fee by GIRO, Visa, Mastercard or Amex.

fact_text: Upon approval, the EP issuance fee is SGD 225 per pass, with an additional SGD 30 for a Multiple Journey Visa if applicable.
evidence_quote: Pay the fees using GIRO, Visa, Mastercard or Amex: $225 for each pass (If applicable) $30 for each Multiple Journey Visa

fact_text: Online EP applications are processed or given an update within 10 business days.
evidence_quote: If you apply online: Processed or given an update within 10 business days.

fact_text: The In-Principle Approval (IPA) letter for an approved EP application serves as a pre-approved single-entry visa, giving the candidate 6 months to enter Singapore and get their pass issued.
evidence_quote: The IPA: Is a pre-approved single-entry visa for the candidate to enter Singapore. It gives the candidate 6 months to enter Singapore and get their pass issued.

fact_text: Short-term travellers holding a passport from a visa-required country must apply for a visa to enter Singapore.
evidence_quote: Short-Term travellers holding a passport or travel document from a visa-required country/region must apply for a Visa

fact_text: All travellers (except certain exempted categories) must submit the SG Arrival Card (SGAC) within three days before arriving in Singapore.
evidence_quote: All travellers are required to submit the SG Arrival Card within three (3) days (including the day of arrival) before arriving in Singapore

fact_text: Employers are required to pay CPF contributions only for employees who are Singapore Citizens or Singapore Permanent Residents earning more than SGD 50 per month — EP holders as foreign nationals are not covered.
evidence_quote: As an employer, you're required to pay CPF contributions for your employees who are Singapore Citizens or Singapore Permanent Residents and who are earning total wages of more than $50 per month.

fact_text: The CPF contribution rate depends on whether the employee is a Singapore Citizen or Singapore Permanent Resident, their age, and total wages.
evidence_quote: The CPF contribution rate applicable depends on whether employee is a Singapore Citizen or Singapore Permanent Resident, age, and total wages.

fact_text: To bring family members on a Dependant's Pass, the EP holder must earn a minimum fixed monthly salary of SGD 6,000.
evidence_quote: Earn a minimum fixed monthly salary of $6,000. This is based on your salary, and not based on your combined household income.

fact_text: Eligible family members for a Dependant's Pass are the EP holder's legally married spouse and unmarried children under 21 years old (including legally adopted children).
evidence_quote: You can get a pass for the following family members: Legally married spouse. Unmarried children under 21 years old, including legally adopted children.

fact_text: Dependant's Pass holders who wish to work in Singapore must obtain a separate work pass — either an Employment Pass, S Pass, or DP Work Permit — through a prospective employer.
evidence_quote: Prospective employers can apply for an Employment Pass (EP), S Pass, or DP-Work Permit (DP-WP) for their DP holders.

fact_text: As an Employment Pass holder, you can get certain family members to join you in Singapore if you earn at least SGD 6,000 a month.
evidence_quote: To be eligible, you need to: Earn at least $6,000 a month. Hold an Employment Pass.

fact_text: The Long-Term Visit Pass is available for the EP holder's common-law spouse, unmarried handicapped children aged 21 and above, and unmarried step-children under 21.
evidence_quote: You can get a pass for the following family members: Common-law spouse. Unmarried handicapped children aged 21 and above. Unmarried step-children under 21 years old.

fact_text: An EP holder can apply for a Long-Term Visit Pass for their parents only if they earn a fixed monthly salary of at least SGD 12,000.
evidence_quote: Parents – only for those earning a fixed monthly salary of at least $12,000.

fact_text: To be eligible to apply for a Long-Term Visit Pass for family members, the EP holder must earn a minimum fixed monthly salary of SGD 6,000.
evidence_quote: Earn a minimum fixed monthly salary of $6,000. This is based on your salary, and not based on your combined household income.

fact_text: The Long-Term Visit Pass (LTVP) is for a common-law spouse, step-child or handicapped child of an Employment Pass or S Pass holder. Pass holders earning over SGD 12,000 can also get a pass for parents.
evidence_quote: The Long-Term Visit Pass (LTVP) is for a common-law spouse, step-child or handicapped child of an Employment Pass or S Pass holder. Pass holders earning over $12,000 can also get a pass for parents.
